note: Human-taught vendor/domain rules. These VETO a line the price history cannot judge. Each rule carries WHO taught it and WHY — provenance is mandatory and is hashed into the signed receipt.

rules.subject: SEN-7781
rules.evidence: Proximity sensors (HD) have been quoted $45-55/unit by three vendors in 2025-2026; we never approve above $60. No price history is on file yet, so only a human rule catches an overcharge here.
A charged unit price must be greater than zero; a non-positive unit price is a misread or a bad line, never a real charge.
Discrete goods (pumps, kits, sensors, bundles) ship in whole units; a fractional quantity indicates an extraction error.
